problems.lede: Every engagement starts from a business problem, not from a technology. Select the one that sounds like yours and follow where it routes.

items.q: We need to build something new.
items.t: From an idea to a product in production
items.b: We turn the intent into a defined scope, a technical architecture and a system that actually ships. Web, mobile or an internal platform, engineered to be maintained after launch.
We map how the work is done today, find the steps that cost the most, and replace them with automated workflows across the systems your teams already use.

items.t: One ecosystem instead of separate tools
items.b: We connect ERP, CRM, databases and third-party services so information moves once and stays consistent, removing double entry and the reporting gaps that come with it.
We assess what must be preserved and what should be rebuilt, then modernize or migrate in stages so the business keeps operating while the platform changes underneath it.

items.q: We want to apply AI where it actually creates value.
items.t: AI applied to a specific business problem
items.b: We start from the process, not the model. Where AI genuinely helps, we build it into the workflow — document and data automation, assistants and agents — and where it does not, we say so.

items.t: A foundation that holds under real load
items.b: Cloud environments, databases, deployment pipelines and monitoring, set up so releases are routine and the cost of running the platform is understood.

items.t: Decisions made before anything is built
items.b: Architecture, stack evaluation and a technology roadmap tied to business priorities, so the next investment is a decision rather than a guess.

meta.title: ERP-WEB · COOPEBANACIO R.L. | BRILER
meta.description: Modernize a critical ERP without stopping the business. BRILER is building ERP-WEB for COOPEBANACIO R.L. through a progressive modernization that coexists with CODEAS.

hero.title: Modernize a critical ERP without stopping the business.
hero.lede: A custom ERP platform built to evolve gradually from a legacy system, while both technology generations coexist.

erpWeb.resultHighlight: Evolve without conditioning the entire transformation on a single abrupt replacement.

problem.title: A critical ERP cannot stop in order to change.
body: COOPEBANACIO runs institutional processes on CODEAS, an ERP that holds years of rules, data and day-to-day operation.
Replacing it in a single cutover creates operational risk: too many dependencies have to be resolved at once, and the business is forced to wait on one break.
The project addresses that problem with a progressive move to a new web platform, so operations can continue while capabilities are transferred.

intervention.title: A new platform, designed to coexist.
body: BRILER designed an ERP architecture around COOPEBANACIO. The platform is meant to coexist with CODEAS while capabilities move across gradually.
Necessary dependencies on the legacy system are encapsulated. New functions can therefore evolve on a modern foundation without requiring a massive initial migration.

A modern platform is already in place. Among other foundations, it includes a web application, an enterprise backend, controlled integration with CODEAS, its own ERP identity, Microsoft Entra ID, SMS campaign capability, and a modular architecture ready to take on new areas over time.

result.title: A new foundation. Replacement is not the result.
body: The publishable result is not that CODEAS has been replaced. The result is that a new technology foundation for the ERP now exists.
Modernization can advance by capability. The legacy system can keep supporting functions that have not yet moved. New capabilities are built on a modern architecture.
The organization does not have to condition the entire transformation on a single abrupt replacement.

depth.title: Enough depth for the people who run the system.
depth.lede: Technology supports the story. It does not replace it. These are the traits of the platform, not an internal inventory.

items.title: Modern web application
items.body: A React interface for the capabilities that already live on the new platform.

items.title: Enterprise backend
items.body: Services in ASP.NET Core on a SQL Server database.

items.title: Identity and operations
items.body: Integration with Microsoft Entra ID, and SMS campaigns as an operational capability.

items.title: Encapsulated integration
items.body: The connection to CODEAS stays controlled so legacy and the new platform can coexist.

items.title: Modular architecture
items.body: Prepared to take on new areas progressively, without a full redesign at every step.

items.title: Durable processing
items.body: Operational capabilities that must complete reliably, not as short-lived one-off tasks.

meta.title: AUTOGESTIÓN · COOPEBANACIO R.L. | BRILER
meta.description: The financial core remains the heart. BRILER builds a custom digital experience for COOPEBANACIO R.L. that connects members to their products without exposing the core.

hero.title: The financial core remains the heart.
hero.titleLine: The experience does not have to feel legacy.
hero.lede: A custom digital experience so members can view and manage their financial products, on an architecture connected to the institutional core.

challenge.title: The data can live in the core. The experience does not have to.
body: COOPEBANACIO keeps products, balances, and financial rules in an existing core. That system is the authority. It must not be exposed to the internet, and its logic must not be duplicated in the frontend.
Members still need a digital channel to view and manage selected capabilities. The architecture has to connect those two worlds without mixing them.

layer.title: A boundary between the member and the core.
layer.lede: BRILER built a custom digital channel. An API controls access and orchestrates permitted operations. The browser does not talk to the core.

points.v: A boundary that decides what can be viewed or operated.
The channel owns the experience. The core owns the finance.
Access, onboarding, and passkeys live in the digital layer.
Products, rules, and member standing stay where they always have.

member.title: One experience for several financial relationships.
member.lede: The channel brings inquiry and selected operations into a clear surface. It is not a window into the internal system.

operate.title: Inquiry is not the limit.
operate.lede: The channel enables selected, controlled operations. Not every product, and not every change: only what the core’s rules authorize.

identity.title: Identity belongs to the channel. Financial standing belongs to the core.
identity.lede: Password, onboarding, and passkeys live in the digital experience. Member standing and products are confirmed against the core.

depth.title: Two domains. One boundary.
depth.lede: The technology holds the separation. The channel can evolve without rewriting the core.

capabilities.title: What this work makes visible.
capabilities.lede: The kinds of intervention this case makes visible.

cta.title: Do your customers need a modern experience on systems you cannot replace?
cta.lede: Tell us the problem. We start with the core that must stay and the experience that is missing.

meta.title: COOPEMERCADITO · COOPEBANACIO R.L. | BRILER
meta.description: An existing community, turned into a trusted digital marketplace. BRILER builds COOPEMERCADITO so members can discover products and services with verification, moderation, and proximity.

hero.title: An existing community.
hero.lede: A custom platform for discovering products and services within the member community, with verification, moderation, and proximity search.

challenge.title: A community does not become a marketplace just by publishing a catalog.
challenge.lede: It needs identity, rules, and a way to find the offer. Discovery can be open. Selling requires trust.

trust.title: Two controls. Two different moments.
trust.lede: Not every account becomes a seller. Not every listing becomes visible.
trust.who: Who sells is tied to the member community.
trust.what: What is published is reviewed before it appears.

discovery.title: Location is part of how the offer is found.
discovery.lede: The catalog is public. Proximity shapes what appears nearby, without exposing the internal system or real member data.

connection.title: The platform makes the meeting possible. The commercial relationship continues between people.
connection.lede: COOPEMERCADITO is not a checkout. Discover, explore, save, and talk is the model. The cooperative does not intermediate payment.

experience.title: One network for several ways of finding each other.
experience.lede: The public surface brings together catalog, profiles, and contact. It is a product composition, not a screenshot.

operations.title: A simple public experience, with controls behind it.
operations.lede: Moderation, administration, roles, and audit hold the network. They are not the lead; they are what makes it institutional.

depth.title: Application, data, geo, and delivery, in layers.
depth.lede: An evolutionary cloud architecture, designed to separate experience, data, geospatial search, and image delivery.

capabilities.title: What this work makes visible.
capabilities.lede: The kinds of intervention this case makes visible.

cta.title: Do you need to turn a community, network, or ecosystem into a digital platform?
cta.lede: Tell us the problem. We start with who belongs and how people find each other.

meta.title: HubSpot ↔ Financial core · COOPEBANACIO R.L. | BRILER
meta.description: The CRM knows the relationship. The core knows the financial reality. BRILER builds a custom integration that turns different structures into useful context across systems.

hero.title: The CRM knows the relationship.
hero.titleLine: The core knows the financial reality.
hero.lede: A custom integration that connects HubSpot commercial information with institutional core data, translating different structures into useful context across systems.

systems.title: Different systems. Different responsibilities.
systems.lede: Neither replaces the other. The value appears when both can share context.

bridge.title: It does not transport. It transforms.
bridge.lede: A middle layer identifies, maps, validates, and routes. The two sides speak different languages.

flow.title: Integration is not copying everything both ways.
flow.lede: Move each record to where it adds value. The integration runs in both directions, with different responsibilities.

mapping.title: The integration understands the business, not just the format.
mapping.lede: The core knows products and standing. HubSpot needs properties and commercial signals. The bridge does that translation.

identity.title: One person. Two systems. One business key.
identity.lede: The match uses a business identity to pair records. Without it, context never reaches the right contact.

control.title: Automate with control, not just move data faster.
control.lede: Batches, validation, dry-run, and controlled create or update. Some flows keep a human confirmation.

depth.title: One engine. Two APIs. No interface to invent.
depth.lede: Python orchestrates the integration. There is no frontend: the engineering is the product.

capabilities.lede: The kinds of intervention this case makes visible.

cta.title: When your systems do not speak the same language, we build the bridge.
cta.lede: Tell us what each system knows. We start with meaning, not with the connector.
